script.text: Chumley entered Industrial Illusions's card design contest and won! But since he hadn't passed his exams yet, Dr. Crowler only agreed to give him a recommendation if he passed his exam.
Chumley hasn’t passed his exams! Now what kind of school would we be to send Pegasus some flunky? If Chumley can beat me in a duel, then I’ll let him go.
But if he loses, he will be expelled immediately!
Don’t be nervous. This duel will simply affect the rest of your life!
Well? Are you waiting for an invitation?
I got one right here! Let’s duel!
